english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comforting someone who is grieving, disappointed, or upset.
Use this when the emphasis is on comforting someone emotionally rather than calming them physically or behaviourally.
Choose this when cheer means offering comfort or consolation to someone who is upset.

examples.english: I stayed with them all night to console them.
examples.traditional: 我陪住佢，安慰咗佢一晚。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 pui4 zyu6 keoi5 on1 wai3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 maan5

examples.english: They were heartbroken, so I chatted with them to soothe them.
examples.traditional: 佢失戀，我陪佢傾偈安慰佢。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 ngo5 pui4 keoi5 king1 gai2 on1 wai3 keoi5

examples.english: I went to cheer up my friend after a breakup.
examples.traditional: 我去安慰下失戀嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 on1 wai3 haa5 sat1 lyun2 ge3 pang4 jau5
